messages:
incident-bot: ALERT triggered: inference-api > error_rate_p95 > 5% for 3m on prod (service=inference-api)
Alice Chen: taking this — I'm oncall now, pulling logs
Raj Patel: i'm looking at LB metrics, seeing a spike in 502s from replica-gpu-4
Mei Wong: adding context — we saw a noisy alert earlier for pod restarts, might be related
Kyle S.: FYI i just finished handoff, no known deploys in last 30m
Alice Chen: good call. @ops-bot can you dump recent requests to /v1/generate for the failing hosts?
ops-bot: attached sample logs for replica-gpu-4 (redacted).
Alice Chen: initial customer impact: a handful of customers reported increased latency + errors; not full outage. lets keep severity scoped but page on-call.
Raj Patel: can we avoid paging infra on every transient blip? this alert is super noisy during GC waves
Mei Wong: agree. post-incident we should tune thresholds and change routing. proposal:
- severity 1 (s1): service-down or >50% errors 5m -> page on-call -> phone escalation
- severity 2 (s2): elevated errors 5-15m -> create ticket in #incidents, notify on-call via mention (no phone)
- severity 3 (s3): minor regressions/latency -> ticket only, no on-call mention
Alice Chen: fine with that. Also add a debounce window and host aggregation so we don't page on single-host flapping
Raj Patel: +1. also add a sliding p95 over 5m instead of instantaneous sample.
Mei Wong: I'll draft the Alertmanager rule. sample patch:
```yaml
- alert: InferenceAPIHighError
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{handler="/v1/generate",code=~"5.."}[5m])) by (service) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{handler="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (service) > 0.2
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Inference API 5xx rate high ({{ $labels.service }})"
```
Mei Wong: change severity/thresholds in the rule and add `group_by: [service]` and `repeat_interval: 1m` in the receiver config
Alice Chen: i'll open a follow-up ticket for the routing change and dashboard work: TICKET-4123 (owners: Mei + Raj). Can we get a quick dashboard showing error rate by region + host and a rollup p95?
Raj Patel: i'll add the panels. will include host-aggregation and alert burn rate graph.
Kyle S.: doc note — update runbook: what counts as customer-impacting (errors+latency thresholds), and explicit page vs ticket examples. I'll own the runbook PR.
Mei Wong: also let's mute the noisy pod-restart alert during GC window for 30m while we stabilize. I'll create a temporary suppression rule.
Alice Chen: mitigation: scaling one additional replica in us-west, and rolling restart of replica-gpu-4.
ops-bot: scaling action queued -> +1 replica to inference-prod-us-west.
Alice Chen: after restart error rate returned to baseline for that host. monitoring shows p95 latency improved.
Alice Chen: closing incident thread for now. action items:
- TICKET-4123: alert routing + severity mapping (Mei, Raj)
- Runbook PR: clarify page vs ticket + examples (Kyle)
- Dashboard: error rate by region/host & p95 rollup (Raj)
- Temporary suppression for pod-restart noise (Mei)
Alice Chen: tagging for post-incident review in weekly eng-sre sync. thanks all :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: thanks — will follow up with patch and dashboards in a few hours
Mei Wong: patch open in alerting repo, will link in ticket
Kyle S.: done with runbook draft, will ping reviewers
incident-bot: Incident incident-1799998888 transitioned to RESOLVED at 1799999255
Alice Chen: marking handoff — next oncall @Kyle S. for 15:00-23:00 UTC
